source_grounding.source_excerpt: lib/storage/src/content_manager/alias_mapping.rs:15-16: pub struct AliasMapping(HashMap<Alias, CollectionId>) (single instance-wide alias->collection map, one row per alias name); :66-70 pub fn insert(&mut self, alias: String, collection_name: String) -> Result<(), StorageError> { self.alias_mapping.0.insert(alias, collection_name); self.alias_mapping.save(&self.data_path)?; Ok(()) } — plain HashMap overwrite: create_alias over an existing alias name atomically REPLACES the single row, so 16 A<->B rebinds of LIVE cannot leave residual LIVE rows; :83-93 pub fn remove_collection(&mut self, collection_name: &str) { ... self.alias_mapping.0.retain(|_, v| v != collection_name); ... } — dropping a collection removes its rows. lib/storage/src/content_manager/toc/mod.rs:452-468: /// List of all aliases across all collections; pub async fn list_aliases(&self, access: &Access) -> Result<Vec<AliasDescription>, StorageError> { let all_collections = self.all_collections(access).await; let mut aliases: Vec<AliasDescription> = Default::default(); for collection_pass in &all_collections { for alias in self.collection_aliases(collection_pass, access).await? { aliases.push(AliasDescription { alias_name: alias.clone(), collection_name: collection_pass.to_string() }); } } Ok(aliases) } — GET /aliases iterates EVERY existing collection and unions their rows: any existing foreign collection's alias (sem_gdc1_al_1929a5ad on the existing sem_gdc1_81ce0571) necessarily appears; the docstring is the explicit design statement. src/common/collections.rs:167-188 do_list_collection_aliases: first auth.check_collection_access(collection_name, ...) (404 CollectionDoesNotExist path for unknown collections — the assertion's negative branch is implemented), then maps toc.collection_aliases(&collection_pass) -> CollectionsAliasesResponse { aliases } with collection_name = the queried collection (a per-collection face can never contain a foreign row). docs/redoc/v1.18.x/openapi.json: GET /aliases description 'Get list of all existing collections aliases'; GET /collections/{collection_name}/aliases 'List aliases for collection | Get list of all aliases for a collection'.

REST GET /aliases -> actix get_aliases (collections_api.rs:48-57) -> do_list_aliases (common/collections.rs:190-196) -> toc.list_aliases (toc/mod.rs:452-468) = union over all_collections. No code path produces the anomaly the verdict asserts.
